text:
About 86% of people aged 15 and over were literate in 2015, according to UNESCO Institute for Statistics estimates. That is roughly 91% of men and 82% of women. The team note is wrong to say literacy fell to the low eighties and declined in most regions. Global literacy has risen over time, and about 14% of adults, not "fewer than one in five," could not read.

CONFIDENCE: 86
